blocks.content: Quiz: What is the main reason to show an explicit No entries yet message instead of leaving the list area blank?
Tap an option below to answer:
To improve performance when the list is empty
The reason is user experience, not performance.
The reason is user experience, not performance.
So the user knows the app is working and what to do next
Empty space can look like an error; a message fixes this issue by giving the appropriate feedback.
Empty space can look like an error; a message fixes this issue by giving the appropriate feedback.
Because React requires something to be rendered in every branch
React allows null or empty. Instead, the message is there to provide clarity for the user.
React allows null or empty. Instead, the message is there to provide clarity for the user.
To prevent errors when entries is an empty array
JavaScript map returns [] on an empty array. Instead; the reason is improved user experience.
